title: Local-first key-line triage for multi-service incidents
user_role: On-call backend developers whose multi-service logs drown the decisive line
scene: A paging alert or user-reported error during an on-call shift creates a need to triage
task: Locate the decisive log line before deciding whether to escalate or roll back
current_substitute: Grep chains, dashboards per service, or hosted APM ingest
friction: Noise lines outnumber decisive events, context switching between services, or shipping raw logs off-site
consequence: Slow escalation decisions and long time-to-restore
acceptance_conditions: Local-only processing, redaction on by default, explicit triage command, and no network calls
gaps: Redaction guarantees are not tested in real teams
next_test: Run a real two-week team pilot with predeclared redaction-rejection and retained-use thresholds
